text:
Jordan: Heads up — preflight for AMS region cutover. Need quick ownership check + any blockers before we schedule the canary. Targeting next Wed window.

Anika: I own routing config + proxy rules. Will post the small PR in a minute. main change is a route weight + fallback to eu-west-1.

Liam: KMS side: key is provisioned (alias/redwood/ams) but still pending IAM binding from security. I pinged @Maria for audit plus policy review.

Ravi: DB replication: read-replica in AMS is healthy, replication lag < 100ms in staging. Need backup window for final bootstrap — prefer 1h early-morning.

Maria: Confirmed I'll review KMS policy today. Also flag: compliance needs retention policy set for logs before we mark region live.

Jordan: thanks. Two quick asks: 1) post PR/links so oncall can validate; 2) call out any manual steps for cutover.

Anika: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/routing/compare/ams-cutover — contains nginx map + weight adjustments. Manual step: toggle canary flag in console (route.policy.canary = true).

Liam: KMS PR: https://git.internal/security/keys/pull/412 — waiting on Maria. Manual step: attach key policy to service account `svc-redwood-ams` (one-liner below).

Liam: ```
# attach policy
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/ams/keyRings/regions --member=serviceAccount:svc-redwood-ams@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
```

Ravi: DB runbook: final bootstrap requires promoting replica to hot-read-only for 15m then snapshot. I'll add commands to the runbook. ETA for runbook update: EOD today.

Maria: Reviewing KMS PR now, will approve if IAM docs included. Also creating retention ticket: #INC-7893.

deploy-bot: Smoke pipeline scheduled for 2026-03-24T09:00:00Z. Steps: routing-check, kms-lookup, db-read, e2e-latency.

Jordan: Great — action items summary: Anika post PR (done), Liam finish KMS binding after Maria approval, Ravi update runbook + schedule backup, Maria approve KMS + open retention ticket, ops-oncall to run smoke at scheduled time.

ops-oncall: Got it. Calendar invite for canary smoke + rollback window sent to #eng-platform and #eng-oncall. I'll be online for the cutover.

Anika: I'll add a short snippet to the console docs explaining the canary toggle and fallback policy.

Jordan: If any of you hit blockers, drop them here. Otherwise we'll go ahead with the canary next Wed during the 09:00-11:00 UTC window. :thumbsup:

Liam: small FYI — CDN edge config needs a cache-busting header tweak. Filing PR after KMS lands.

Ravi: tagging @Anika for the cache header impact on proxy.

Anika: noted — will coordinate.

Jordan: Thanks team. Closing thread — will reopen if any blockers pop up.
